sloka: न एवम् विधम् असत्कारम् राघवो मर्षयिष्यति ।बलवान् इव शार्दूलो बालधेर् अभिमर्शनम् ॥२-६१-१९॥
transliteration: na evam vidham asatkāram rāghavo marṣayiṣyati ।balavān iva śārdūlo bāladher abhimarśanam ॥2-61-19॥

translations.english: Rama, highly determined will not suffer this indignity. If enraged, he can split open even mount Mandara with his sharp arrows.
